# met / mett

## Infinitive

| Dialett | Italiano | English |
|---|---|---|
| **met / mett** | mettere | to put |

| Gerundio | Participio passato † | Verb class |
|---|---|---|
| metendo | metüü | 3rd conjugation: infinitive with no ending (Italian -ere, unstressed ending) |
